messages.subject: options dataset error
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to run a R code in JAVA using RMS. All going well until I had to set options for the dataset. When I try to do that it returns me the error:

"object '.Options' not found"

I have the library(rms) included.
I am doing this:

dd = datadist(data)
options(datadist='dd')

Script Engine version: 0.8.2300
RMS version : 3.6-3-b12

Can someone help me?
Best Regards,
